name: sine-relative
comment: Runs on its OWN copy of the benchmark under relative-error-benchmarks/, not on benchmarks/FPBench/sine.pvs: PRECiSA writes sine_cert.pvs and sine_num_cert.pvs next to the input file, so sharing the input with sine.test.json would have this run overwrite the byte-for-byte regression baseline in tests/relative-error-baseline/ with --relative-error content. NOTE: --typecheck would hand the resulting *_rel_* lemmas and proof scripts to proveit; those are UNVERIFIED and have never been typechecked or proved, so a --typecheck run of this descriptor is expected to be inconclusive at best. Unknown fields such as this one are ignored by testAcceptance.sh, which reads only the keys it names.
